project.name: osameh.dev
project.tagline: An IDE-inspired, repository-driven software engineering portfolio with secure GitHub integration and automated deployment.
project.summary: A React/Vite portfolio that behaves like a developer workspace and repository-driven engineering platform: public GitHub projects self-describe through portfolio.json, project pages expose architecture and source exploration, engineering notes document real implementation decisions, live health diagnostics expose safe operational signals, and staged quality-gated CI/CD delivers the production experience.

concepts: Published client case studies and capability areas

caseStudy.problem: A traditional static portfolio would not demonstrate the depth of engineering work or stay synchronized with an evolving GitHub profile, while the selected shared-hosting environment could not run a persistent Node server.
caseStudy.solution: Use a static React/Vite frontend for fast CDN delivery, pair it with small PHP endpoints for authenticated GitHub access and server-side caching, then automate production delivery with GitHub Actions over a restricted FTPS account.
highlights: IDE-style responsive UI with light/dark themes
Dynamic public GitHub repository discovery
Repository-owned portfolio.json metadata with schema validation
Featured project shortlist and guided Recruiter Mode
Per-project architecture viewer driven by repository metadata
Same-origin GitHub source explorer with file-size and path safeguards
Live GitHub project metrics with language percentages, releases, license and repository signals
README sanitization and repository-wide image galleries
Project case studies, comparison, context menu, command palette and terminal
PWA/offline support, resume viewer and secure contact form
Per-project social previews and CDN-safe 404 routing
GitHub Actions CI/CD with certificate-pinned FTPS deployment
Dynamic project/note structured data and runtime sitemap generation
Staging deployment channel with noindex protection and CI quality gates
Live privacy-safe health center plus Markdown engineering notes
Responsive mobile project navigation, viewport-capped modals, and scroll-synchronized Engineering Notes
Published freelance/client case studies with deep-link SEO metadata plus a separate experience-backed capability layer
Central availability configuration integrated with header, Terminal and recruiter-facing flows
English-only interface contract with fixed en/LTR document metadata and no locale-switching state
Accessibility Control Center with reduced motion, contrast, text scale and enhanced focus preferences
Ranked Command Palette search across projects, notes, case studies, skills, experience and settings

challenges.title: Shared hosting without a Node runtime
challenges.description: The original application architecture used server/runtime assumptions unsuitable for the purchased shared host.
challenges.resolution: Convert the UI to a Vite static build and move only the necessary server-side GitHub/contact logic into small PHP endpoints.

challenges.title: Safe GitHub API usage
challenges.description: A GitHub token must improve rate limits without ever reaching the browser or repository.
challenges.resolution: Keep the token outside the web root, proxy GitHub calls through PHP and cache repository/README/image responses server-side.

challenges.title: CDN behavior and custom routing
challenges.description: CDN caching and upstream error replacement affected deployments and 404 rendering.
challenges.resolution: Use hashed immutable assets, no-cache HTML/build metadata, CDN-safe routing and a noindex soft-404 compatibility layer for the IDE 404 experience.

challenges.title: Automated shared-host deployment
challenges.description: Manual uploads were slow and error-prone, while the FTPS certificate chain was not publicly trusted.
challenges.resolution: Deploy through GitHub Actions using a directory-scoped FTP account and explicit certificate fingerprint pinning before credentials are sent.

results: Static/CDN-friendly production architecture with server-side secret isolation
Portfolio pages stay synchronized with public GitHub repositories
Each repository can own its case study, architecture, recruiter data and source-explorer policy
Recruiters can inspect featured evidence, architecture and public source without leaving the portfolio
Project detail pages combine authored metadata with cached live GitHub metrics and source evidence

architecture.summary: The browser receives a static React/Vite application through ParsPack CDN. Same-origin PHP endpoints provide GitHub, contact and analytics capabilities, while server-side private storage keeps credentials and caches outside the public web root. GitHub Actions builds and deploys the dist directory over pinned FTPS.

recruiter.headline: A repository-driven portfolio and production engineering case study spanning frontend, backend, secure GitHub integration, source exploration, architecture visualization, CDN, and CI/CD.
talkingPoints: Repository-owned portfolio.json files drive case studies, featured work, architecture and source-explorer behavior
Public source is proxied through same-origin PHP endpoints with repository validation, caching and preview limits
Deliberately adapted a modern frontend to constrained shared hosting without exposing secrets
Deployment uses a least-privilege account and pinned FTPS certificate
Project views combine repository-owned metadata with live GitHub language, release, license and activity signals
Uses staging, automated quality gates, browser smoke tests, and Lighthouse checks before production delivery.
Exposes safe live system-health diagnostics and repository-backed engineering notes as first-class product features.
